description: Documented Cint/Lucid campaign image pixels, default reporting metadata and explicit GDPR consent profile. ID spelling, optional video/custom data and account acceptance remain open where public sources do not define them.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: The documented route carries the supplied Lucid campaign ID. Verify that the configured campaign is present; no identifier alphabet or length is inferred.

params.name: sid
params.description: The published default pixel includes this site or publisher reporting field. Missing metadata limits reporting granularity; supplied values remain opaque and account mapping needs external context.

params.name: pid
params.description: The published default pixel includes this placement reporting field. Missing metadata limits reporting granularity; supplied values remain opaque and account mapping needs external context.

params.name: crid
params.description: The published default pixel includes this creative reporting field. Missing metadata limits reporting granularity; supplied values remain opaque and account mapping needs external context.

params.name: cachebuster
params.description: The published Lucid image template supplies cachebuster, and Cint implementation guidance recommends the platform cache-buster macro. A single request cannot prove randomness, freshness or uniqueness.

params.name: idfa
params.description: Optional mobile advertising identifier. Public guidance does not define an identifier alphabet, length or universal presence.

params.name: video_action
params.description: Optional video action. Published start, stop, skip and complete values are examples, so custom action names remain open.

params.name: video_completion
params.description: Optional viewed amount expressed as time or percentage. No exclusive unit, numeric grammar or universal 0-to-100 bound is inferred.

params.name: c1
params.description: Optional custom campaign data. Values, including empty and encoded text, remain opaque.

params.name: c2
params.description: Optional custom campaign data. Values, including empty and encoded text, remain opaque.

params.name: c3
params.description: Optional custom campaign data. Values, including empty and encoded text, remain opaque.

params.name: c4
params.description: Optional custom campaign data. Values, including empty and encoded text, remain opaque.

params.name: c5
params.description: Optional custom campaign data. Values, including empty and encoded text, remain opaque.

params.name: gdpr
params.description: Explicit GDPR applicability signal. Destination consent advice is scoped to observed values that are all literal 1; absence, other values and unresolved macros do not establish jurisdiction.

params.name: gdpr_consent
params.description: Supplied consent is structurally inspected as TCF v2. Local decoding does not establish jurisdiction, current GVL applicability, account acceptance or every TCF 2.2 policy obligation.

rules.message: The documented Lucid measurement profile expects consent when GDPR applicability is explicitly 1.
rules.fix_hint: Provide the applicable TCF consent signal or verify the upstream partner and collection context.

rules.message: The documented Lucid TCF profile expects vendor 508 and purpose consents 1, 7, 8 and 9.
rules.fix_hint: Verify the supplied consent with the publisher/CMP and the deployed Lucid integration.
